threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus is a reliable alternative to the Overground at rush hour. Welcome to the delays and 'no service' surprises!
Caught a group debating the best late-night food spots on the 68 last night. Turns out, the fried chicken at the end of Coldharbour Lane is still the king.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw my neighbor feeding stray cats while balancing her groceries. Only in Neukölln do everyday heroes blend in with the chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, the street artists often tag the same wall multiple times, creating layers of art that tell a story over weeks. It's like living in a gallery that evolves.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name the taco truck near 24th street that’s been there since the 90s, not just the latest trendy spot.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a full mariachi band onboard yesterday. They played all the way down Van Ness. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals eat tapas at bars. In reality, most of us prefer a quiet home-cooked meal over crowded places.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell the newbies in Gràcia—they're the ones still trying to pronounce 'Passeig de Sant Joan' without fumbling the 's'!

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'the pole' refers to a light fixture and not the train station. Watch out; the locals will side-eye you for that one!
Caught a bloke singing opera on the 333 last night, completely lit. Tourists loved it, but the driver looked ready to jump off the bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted the old lady in the park arguing with a pigeon over a pretzel crumb. That’s when it hit me—this place has character.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a spontaneous karaoke bar in a back alley, just a worn-out mic and a crowd of locals belting out 90s hits under fairy lights.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they complain about the BART breaks being too hot to handle, but still choose it over Muni every time.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw someone juggle while waiting for the 31, and a guy in a suit ignored it completely, glued to his phone. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars close early, but the locals know the best ones get lively after midnight, filled with hidden gems and late-night tapas.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They'll be the ones struggling with 'escudella' pronunciation while trying to order it at the local eatery.
